description: What a verification SMS to this phone number would cost, in credits, and the number's country (`region_code`, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; `null` when the number belongs to no assigned range). Nothing is sent. The price is for this number's carrier, so it can differ from the country's price in the price list. Group: Pricing. Billing per call: 0 Credits, Requests: metered (~0.36 avg).
